sections.text: مقدمة

This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block

In 
 machines with a closed air circuit, some air is bound to leak, it must 
 be replaced by air drawn in through filters, the two leakage air filters are 
 located on the face-end outer casings of the generator, which means they are 
 at the points with the least static pressure. Particular care is to be taken 
 to ensure that these filters maintained properly.

This document 
 initiated by eng. Ayman Mohamed M. Taha, tested by eng. Maher Abdel Gawad 
 Salem, accepted by eng. Mohamed Alsayed Ahmed, and approved by eng. Mohamed Salah Eldin Abd 
 Elghafar: general director of Wadi Hof Power Station.

This document 
 revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and 
 certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's 
 Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.

sections.text: العمل الذي يتعين القيام به
Cleaning

Clean the filters from contaminated 
 atmospheric dust by tapping carefully, or by blowing through with compressed 
 air.
Wash with warm water if needed.

However, if the dust extracted by the filters is greasy, an ordinary 
 commercial detergent should be added to the water.
إذا كان دهنيًا جدًا، يمكن استخدام ثلاثي كلوريد الإيثيلين للتنظيف.
استبدل المرشحات التالفة أو الملوثة بشدة بمرشحات جديدة.
